beats.line: US & Russia Negotiate Again. Almost nobody knows how this ended.
American spy planes discovered Soviet nuclear missiles hidden on the island of Cuba.
beats.subject: Cuba

beats.line: Soviet Premier Nikita Khrushchev secretly shipped the warheads to balance American weapons deployed near his border.
beats.subject: Nikita Khrushchev 1962

beats.line: US President John F. Kennedy rejected an immediate military strike and ordered a naval quarantine instead.
beats.subject: John F. Kennedy

beats.line: American warships blocked the Caribbean Sea while Soviet vessels steamed directly toward them.
beats.subject: Caribbean Sea blockade 1962

beats.line: The two superpowers stood face to face on the edge of total nuclear destruction.
Kennedy secretly removed his missiles from Turkey, but Khrushchev suffered the humiliating public retreat that ended his political career.
